title: Minimum Score Triangulation Of Polygon
description:
A polygon has `n` vertices in order, with `values[i]` assigned to vertex `i`. Triangulate the polygon using diagonals that do not cross. Each triangle has score equal to the product of its three vertex values. Return the minimum total score among all triangulations.

## Examples

```text
Input: values = [1, 2, 3]
Output: 6
```

```text
Input: values = [3, 7, 4, 5]
Output: 144
```

```text
Input: values = [1, 3, 1, 4, 1, 5]
Output: 13
```

## Constraints

- `3 <= values.length <= 50`
- `1 <= values[i] <= 100`
